One talk per speaker. Spread across categories, not repeats. Include everyone flagged as a known-great speaker. Nigeria-based submissions are higher travel/visa risk unless the talk is exceptional. Cobalt Analytics is the only company with more than one speaker in the pool — James McGillivray, Michael Johnson and Michael Victor all work there (flagged on their cards). AI shortlist tiebreak on equal score: an unknown speaker beats a known-not-great one, and local/domestic travel beats international.
